metadata.summary: A defiant Michael Carrick has insisted there is no divide in the Manchester United dressing room and backed himself to turn things around at Old Trafford amid growing uncertainty over his future.

The under-pressure United head coach began his news conference with an emotional statement lasting more than five minutes, admitting "we've lost our way" as he called on his players to "respect the club". United are winless in their last seven matches, their longest such run since 2015, and those problems have spilled out beyond the pitch over the last fortnight with captain Bruno Fernandes and Lisandro Martinez airing their frustrations publicly. metadata.summary: England head coach Brian McDermott has made one change to his 19-man squad for Saturday's Rugby League World Cup match against France.
metadata.content: Rugby League World Cup: Mikey Lewis on bench as England squad named for clash vs France after opening defeat | Rugby League News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Update Rugby League World Cup: Mikey Lewis on bench as England squad named for clash vs France after opening defeat England take on France in Perth on Saturday (7.35am kick-off BST) for second Rugby League World Cup fixture, having been thrashed by Tonga in opener; England play Papua New Guinea in Wollongong on October 30; England Women began their campaign with big win vs Wales in Perth Friday 23 October 2026 10:42, UK Image: Mikey Lewis has made the England bench for the first time in the tournament England head coach Brian McDermott has made one change to his 19-man squad for Saturday's Rugby League World Cup match against France. AJ Brimson retains the job at full-back with Jack Welsby again named as an interchange, while Luke Thompson starts at prop in the absence of Morgan Knowles, who suffered an injury in the lead-up to the opening-game defeat to Tonga. Veteran centre Kallum Watkins is listed among the reserves as he chases a cap at his fourth World Cup, while Mikey Lewis returns to the bench after missing out on a place in the squad last time out. As per World Cup rules, each side is able to name a six-player bench in each game, but only four of the six players named can be brought on.
